title: Joshua Stewart Cloud Context Pack - Source Registry Schema
description: Schema for sources.json, the knowledge-supply-chain registry of external sources this pack's skills cite or check for freshness. Validated offline by scripts/check-freshness.mjs, which implements a small hand-written subset of JSON Schema (type, required, properties, items, enum, pattern, format: date|uri, minItems, minLength, minimum, additionalProperties) sufficient to check this file — it is not a general-purpose JSON Schema engine. Entries are link-only by default: this registry records where a fact lives, never the fact itself. The one exception is the optional versionProbe object, which permits a bounded fetch of a small machine-readable version document; see its own description. The $id above names this repository's intended canonical GitHub location; the repository has not been published/pushed yet, so treat this URL as aspirational until confirmed reachable.

registryVersion.description: Semantic version of the registry file's own shape, independent of the pack's VERSION.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the registry as a whole.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier for this source.

canonicalUrl.description: The single authoritative URL for this source. Prefer a stable/canonical form over a redirect.

authority.description: What kind of authority this source has over the topic it covers.

licenseTreatment.description: Cautious, explicit statement of how this pack is permitted to use the source: link-only, format-inspiration-no-copy, verbatim-reuse-under-named-license, etc. Must never assert a right the pack has not actually verified.

retrievalPolicy.description: link-only: never fetched by tooling, human-checked only. metadata-only: scripts/check-freshness.mjs may perform a headers-only (HEAD, or GET with body immediately discarded) reachability/drift check; body content is never read or stored. pinned-snapshot: a specific commit/version was reviewed and pinned via pinnedCommit; no live drift checking. manual-review-only: never checked automatically, by policy, regardless of technical feasibility.

volatility.description: stable: rarely changes in ways that affect this pack (e.g. a ratified legal text). versioned: changes in discrete, citable releases. volatile: can change at any time without a version marker (e.g. a living docs page).

owner.description: Person or role accountable for reviewing this entry.

lastReviewed.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this entry was last human-reviewed against its canonicalUrl. Must not be in the future.

reviewAfterDays.description: Days after lastReviewed before this entry is considered overdue for re-review. Should track the volatility tier (see FRESHNESS.md).

appliesTo.description: Repository-relative paths whose content depends on this source staying accurate.

versionProbe.description: Optional. Opts this source into a bounded, machine-readable version check, run only by scripts/check-freshness.mjs --network via scripts/lib/version-probe.mjs. Use it only where the dependency has a primary machine-readable registry; the human-readable documentation stays in canonicalUrl. The probe fetches ONE small JSON version document under hard size and time limits, extracts only the latest stable version string, and discards the rest — it never reads, stores or reproduces documentation prose. A probe can only ever open review work (exit code 2); it never edits this file and never marks a version current on its own. Note: scripts/lib/version-probe.mjs additionally tolerates a free-text 'notes' key; this schema deliberately does not, so every probe in this repository keeps the same four-field shape.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the primary machine-readable version registry for this dependency (not a documentation page). Must return JSON.

format.description: How to extract a version from the response. npm-latest: an npm registry document exposing dist-tags.latest or version. nuget-index: a NuGet flat-container index exposing a 'versions' array. dotnet-release-index: the .NET releases-index.json, from which the highest stable latest-release across supported channels is taken. github-latest: a GitHub releases/latest document exposing tag_name.

testedVersion.description: The exact version this pack's content is coordinated to, in semver form. This is an anchor, not a claim that the version is current: FRESHNESS.md records, per entry, whether that version was executed here or only resolved from its registry. Update it only after a human re-checks the affected content.

alertOn.description: How large a bump above testedVersion should open review work. major: only a new major line. minor: a new major or minor line. any: any newer stable release. Smaller bumps are still recorded, just not escalated.

pinnedCommit.description: Optional. Git commit SHA (short or full) of permissibly reused repository material, when retrievalPolicy is pinned-snapshot. Omit entirely when not applicable; do not use a placeholder value.

notes.description: Optional free-text context, e.g. observed redirects or caveats found during review.
